description_en: Queries the information about the acceleration region of a basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用GetBasicIpSet接口查询指定基础型全球加速实例的加速地域信息
kebab_example: aliyun ga get-basic-ip-set --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --ip-set-id ips-bp11r5jb8ogp122xl0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetBasicIpSet

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the basic GA instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **request ID** as the **client token**. The **request ID** may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the acceleration region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2253380.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的加速地域实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2253380.html查询加速地域实例ID
parameters.name: ip_set_id
